title: Donations (Spenden) limit
summary: Donations to eligible recipients for tax-privileged purposes (§§ 52 to 54 AO) are deductible up to 20 percent of the total amount of income (Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte).
conditions: Recipient is a domestic or EU/EEA public body, or a tax-exempt body under § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 9 KStG, or a comparable EU/EEA body

sources.label: ELSTER Anleitung 2025, Anlage Sonderausgaben, Zeilen 5 bis 12

notes: ELSTER 2025: donations and membership fees for tax-privileged purposes (Zeilen 5 and 6) count up to 20 percent of the Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte. Not deductible, for example: membership fees for sports, leisure-type cultural activities, local heritage. Donations to political parties and voter associations are a separate tax reduction (Zeilen 7 and 8), not covered here.
